module_summary: Synchronous valid/ready FIFO: a pointer/occupancy controller child advances head/tail and fill on push/pop strobes, a register-file child stores entries written at tail and read at head.

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Producer push request; with not-full forms the push strobe.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Push-side ready, asserted when FIFO is not full.

anchors.name: in_data
anchors.why: Write data payload driven into the storage bank write port.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Pop-side valid, asserted when FIFO is not empty.

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Consumer ready; with not-empty forms the pop strobe.

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Read data from the storage bank at the head pointer.

anchors.name: lvl
anchors.why: Occupancy count from controller; decoded into full/empty and exported as count.

anchors.name: rd_at
anchors.why: Read (head) pointer from controller addressing bank read port.

anchors.name: wr_at
anchors.why: Write (tail) pointer from controller addressing bank write port.

anchors.name: give
anchors.why: Push strobe: bank write enable and controller increment.

anchors.name: take
anchors.why: Pop strobe: controller decrement / head advance.

anchors.name: brim
anchors.why: Full flag: blocks push strobe and deasserts in_ready.

anchors.name: dry
anchors.why: Empty flag: blocks pop strobe and deasserts out_valid.

anchors.name: count_o
anchors.why: Occupancy count output, copy of lvl.

groups.name: handshake_logic
groups.description: Converts valid/ready handshakes plus full/empty into push and pop strobes.

groups.name: pointer_controller
groups.description: sf_ctl child keeps head, tail and fill; full/empty decoded from fill.

groups.name: storage_bank
groups.description: sf_bank register file written at tail on push, read at head.
